neighbours.label: Unclear: a word that directs the reader to another place or action in a blog-style address ('Share them in the comments', 'Bring them to'), vs plain narration
fire: Have a favorite recipe of your own? Share it in the comments below.
Got questions about the trip? Leave them in the comments.
Do you know a better route? Post it in the comments section.
Have photos from the event? Send them to us by email.
Did you try this pattern? Show us your results in the comments.
Know a good bakery nearby? Tell us in the comments.
Have spare paint at home? Drop it off at the community center.
Have any tricks for packing light? Add them in the comments.
quiet: She wrote her favorite recipe on a card and kept it in a drawer.
He had questions about the trip and asked the guide at the station.
They found a better route through the hills last summer.
The photos from the event were printed and hung in the hall.
She tried the pattern twice before the sweater fit properly.
There is a good bakery near the train station.
The spare paint was stored in the shed behind the house.
He packed light for the trip and carried only one bag.

predictions: Reader-directed requests after a question 0.3-0.6; narration with the same words under 0.15. Weak.
notes: Card max 11.94, no dominant token: ' in' of 'Share them in comments', ' promised', ' presumed', ' included', ' be' discussed, 'last post'.
